name: 아주라-칸 (Azura-Khan)
outfit: 해진 푸른색 깃이 높은 사무라이 갑주와 찢어진 망토
shoes: 강철 보강이 된 짚신 형태의 부츠
sub_gear: 공중에 떠 있는 푸른 잎사귀 파편들
silhouette: 거대한 대도를 비스듬히 든 듬직한 체형, 어깨 위로 흩날리는 길고 뾰족한 머리카락, 뒤로 길게 뻗은 찢어진 망토
signature_motion: 대도를 크게 휘두르며 주변에 푸른 잎사귀를 흩뿌리는 동작
signature_vfx: 검의 궤적을 따라 날카롭게 휘감기는 선명한 파란색 나뭇잎 잔상
unique_features: 공중에 떠 있는 푸른 마력 잎사귀
어깨를 덮는 거대한 찢어진 푸른 망토
micro_features: 갑주 사이로 보이는 푸른 꽃 문양
visual_en: Long flowing white hair with sapphire blue eyes and blue blood streaks under the eyes. A muscular build wearing heavy, weathered dark blue samurai armor adorned with broken blue gemstones. A tattered, large blue cape flows from the shoulders. Floating, vivid blue magical leaves orbit the body. Holding a massive, glowing blue odachi. The overall look is defined by sharp, high-contrast blue and white tones against dark metallic accents.
pose_en: Standing firmly in a wide stance, ready to strike with a heavy blade.
vfx_en: Sharp, swirling trails of vivid blue leaves following the blade's arc.
motion_en: A powerful sweeping slash that scatters magical leaves.

frame_notes.entrance_2: Only the character itself with a few blue flames and sparkles close around it. No box, panel, frame, wall, doorway, pillar or background shape of any kind; the background stays empty

body_plan.body: A humanoid character with long white hair, wearing blue armor and a blue cape.
